lines.zh: 我不会走，是被谁推了一下。
lines.en: I cannot walk; someone nudged me.
I rock once and lean back into place.

lines.zh: 我的纸板边角在刮地板。
lines.en: My cardboard corner scrapes the floor.
The wind tips me to one side.
I have no legs, only a sheet.
I get dragged half a block.

lines.zh: 我的重量轻得像张海报。
lines.en: I weigh as much as a poster.
I slide and lean on the wall.
I cannot stand alone; I need support.
My shadow is thicker than I am.
I am tipping, but not down yet.
I should not be in this hallway.
I stand in the corner, expressionless.

lines.zh: 我只是一块立着的纸板。
lines.en: I am only a standing board.
My grin is printed flat.
I look the same from every angle.
I neither breathe nor move.
My edges are starting to curl.
I was placed here as decoration.

lines.zh: 灯照在我身上，没有影子。
lines.en: The light hits me with no depth.
The stand behind me is crooked.

lines.zh: 我就这么立着，等人经过。
lines.en: I just stand here for someone to pass.
My eyes are printed on cardboard.

lines.zh: 你从正面看我，我才完整。
lines.en: I only look whole from the front.
I lean as you pass sideways.

lines.zh: 我盯不住你，我只是画着。
lines.en: I cannot track you; I am only drawn.

lines.zh: 你走到我侧面，我就薄了。
lines.en: Step to my side and I go thin.

lines.zh: 我的笑永远朝一个方向。
lines.en: My grin always faces one way.
You touch my edge.
I will say nothing at all.
You shine a light and I go pale.

lines.zh: 我在你的视线里很安静。
lines.en: I am very quiet in your sight.
A dent sinks into my board.
I lean over and do not get up.
My printed grin creases.

lines.zh: 你的手穿过了我的边缘。
lines.en: Your hand passes through my edge.
My stand snaps.
I get a little flatter.
I feel no pain, only damage.
My bottom edge curls.
One corner folds down.
I keep smiling as my surface splits.
My arms are painted on.

lines.zh: 它掉在我面前，我无动于衷。
lines.en: It falls before me and I do not react.
I have no mouth to eat with.
You hold it up; I can only look.
It slides down against me.
I cannot even reach out.
You are teasing a piece of cardboard.
I keep smiling, as an answer.
You bump me and I fall over.

lines.zh: 我的纸板弯了一下，弹回来。
lines.en: My board bends and springs back.
I slide half a block from the wall.
You step on my bottom edge.
I lie on the floor, still smiling.
My corner pokes your foot.
You set me upright again.
I press flat against your leg.
My stand is knocked crooked.
I wobble for a long time.
Two cardboard boards lean together.

lines.zh: 我们的笑对着同一个方向。
lines.en: Our grins face the same way.
We hold each other upright.
Our corners overlap.

lines.zh: 我们一模一样，只是歪度不同。
lines.en: We are identical, only tilted differently.
We block this doorway together.
Our shadows join.
They stand side by side on a display.
Neither of us will ever move.
Their stands tangle together.
It is stuck beneath my bottom edge.

lines.zh: 它滚到我脚边就不动了。
lines.en: It rolls to my feet and stops.
You tuck it behind me.

lines.zh: 我背后多了点东西，看不见。
lines.en: Something is behind me, unseen.

lines.zh: 它让我的影子鼓了一块。
lines.en: It makes my shadow bulge.
I hold my original pose.
It gets creased under me.
You take it from my front.
I give no reaction at all.
I keep grinning, keep facing forward.
You have stood before me a long while.
My eyes cannot focus.
I do not even know you came.

lines.zh: 纸板上没有愤怒的印子。
lines.en: No anger is printed on this board.

lines.zh: 我不能选目标，我只是画着。
lines.en: I cannot choose a target; I am only an image.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我的平面上。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on my flat surface.
I will do nothing.
Wait as long as you like; I will not come.

lines.zh: 我的沉默也是一种回答。
lines.en: My silence is also an answer.
You take my grin for a threat.
The light shifts; I do not.
The corner of my mouth will not change.

lines.zh: 我只是被摆在你的路上。
lines.en: I was merely placed in your path.

lines.zh: 你退开了，我仍贴在原处。
lines.en: You step back; I stay propped right here.

lines.zh: 你看我第二次，我还是那个角度。
lines.en: Look twice; I am at the same angle.

lines.zh: 你不会记得我什么时候来的。
lines.en: You will not recall when I arrived.

lines.zh: 我总是在你的视野边缘。
lines.en: I am always at the edge of your view.
You walk off; I still face this way.
My grin is clear even in the dark.
You have looked back twice.
I do not chase; I stay right here.
There is one of me behind every door.
You count how many boards are left.

lines.zh: 我的影子跟着灯一起移。
lines.en: My shadow moves with the lamp.

lines.zh: 我从走廊尽头望着这边。
lines.en: I watch from the end of the hallway.
The longer you look, the more I seem to move.
In truth I have not shifted a step.
I do not need to come closer.
My position has never changed.

lines.zh: 你的影子正好落在我身上。
lines.en: Your shadow falls right across me.

lines.zh: 我始终朝着走廊这一头。
lines.en: I always face this end of the hall.

lines.zh: 你走过三次，我姿势没变。
lines.en: You pass three times; my pose is the same.

lines.zh: 灯光换了个角度，我亮了一块。
lines.en: The light shifts and one patch of me brightens.
I seem to wait for you to remember something.
I cannot even lift an arm.

lines.zh: 你从我身上撞过去，纸板弯了。
lines.en: You crash through me and I bend.
My corner nicks you.
I fall and land on your foot.

lines.zh: 这不是攻击，是我的重心。
lines.en: This is not an attack; it is my balance.
The wind pushes me into you.
My frame grazes your face.
My board slaps your leg.
I tip and hit your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我没有恶意，也没有力气。
lines.en: I bear no malice, and no strength.
You push me and I fall your way.
The blow is as light as paper.
Cardboard edges cut.
You flatten one corner of me.
I stick to you, uncomfortably.
You kick me aside.
My bottom edge trips your foot.
You smash off one of my corners.
You knock me around to face away.

lines.zh: 纸板边缘割破你的指缝。
lines.en: A cardboard edge cuts between your fingers.
A standee has appeared in the hall.
Someone propped me by the door.
A grin has appeared under the light.

lines.zh: 我一直都在，只是你没注意。
lines.en: I was always here; you just missed me.
There used to be only wall here.
I was moved from the corner to the middle.

lines.zh: 一具纸板忽然立起来了。
lines.en: A board suddenly stands upright.
You hear cardboard scrape the floor.
My grin shows in the door gap.

lines.zh: 这块地方多了一件摆设。
lines.en: This spot gained an ornament.
I am propped at the arcade entrance.
The wind straightens me slightly.

lines.zh: 火从我下沿烧上来，边缘发黑。
lines.en: Fire climbs my lower edge and blackens it.
I fall face down.

lines.zh: 水把我泡软，我塌成一团。
lines.en: Water soaks me soft and I sag.
The blast tears me in two.
An arrow punches a hole in my chest.

lines.zh: 那股力量把我的颜色褪了。
lines.en: That force drains my colors.
I never ate anything anyway.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，边缘焦黑。
lines.en: Lightning chars my edges.
I fall, turning over.
